title: Why you get sick when it gets cold 🥶
description:
Why do we get sick in winter? It's not just being inside more. When cold air hits, the inside of your nose cools down and its virus-fighting defence gets weaker, so viruses get an easier way in. Cyto breaks it down from the 6ix.

Source (PubMed): Huang et al., J Allergy Clin Immunol 2023 — https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jaci.2022.09.037

Not medical advice.
